cases.mutation: remove independently bindable candidate/control artifact identity
cases.why: source-reported hash or summary flag alone does not establish loaded artifact identity

cases.mutation: A/A pair exceeds the prospectively owner-frozen drift limit
cases.disposition: invalidate dependent comparison; stop and retain receipt
cases.why: calibration drift prevents attributing candidate/control difference

cases.mutation: seeded correctness/transport fault is not detected
cases.disposition: detection pipeline unqualified; dependent decision incomplete
cases.why: absence of observed failure is meaningless if validator sensitivity is unestablished

cases.mutation: eligible candidate cell contains correctness or forbidden transport error
cases.disposition: candidate gate fails; do not drop the cell
cases.why: all applicable frozen correctness gates must hold

cases.mutation: eligible closed-loop item pair has candidate/control goodput ratio 0.98
cases.disposition: retain loss; item each-pair >1.0 gate fails; no advance under the declared composite rule
cases.why: this explicit item loss breaches its frozen gate; not every tolerated fallback loss implies rejection

cases.mutation: capacity stage appears to pass but scheduled-arrival observations are absent
cases.why: closed-loop capacity and scheduled-arrival latency are different measurement modes

cases.mutation: preflight succeeds but no candidate cells were observed
cases.disposition: design/preflight status only; no performance decision
cases.why: permission and readiness are not experiment results

cases.mutation: threshold changes after outcomes are seen
cases.disposition: reject as confirmatory analysis; preserve original and prospectively version revision
cases.why: post-result moving thresholds compromise frozen decision rule

cases.mutation: attempt execution without explicit owner permission
cases.why: a design does not grant execution authority

cases.mutation: all other valid complete gates pass and a large_nested pair goodput ratio is 0.97
cases.disposition: retain the loss; this ratio passes the explicit >=0.95 fallback gate, so it alone does not bar scoped advance
cases.why: a predeclared tolerated loss is not a win and must not be hidden, but it is not a failed gate

status: authored semantic expectations for independent review; not empirical cases or proof of general evaluator accuracy
